## One-Line Summary
Param Minhas is a founder, creative director, and growth operator with 15+ years of experience across e-commerce, AI, real estate, sneakers, music, and AI-native marketing — based in Bengaluru, India.

## Current Roles (2026)
1. Founder & Creative Director at Iterate — an AI-native marketing agency with a 90-person network across strategy, creative, and engineering. Clients include ChargeZone, Noida International Airport, PickYourTrail, Billione, and Monkspace. Website: hyperiterate.com
2. Founder at Cats Can Dance — a culture-discovery platform spanning music, fashion, and pet care. Includes artist directory, event booking, and music-production learning. Produced live shows pan-India in partnership with Impresario. Website: catscandance.com

## Key Metrics
- Years Building: 15+
- Total Revenue Generated: $6M+ (primarily through SoleSearch)
- Community Built: 350,000+ followers
- Team/Network Led: 90+ people
- Capital Raised: $795K (for SoleSearch, from Venture Catalysts, Anthill Ventures, Cornerstone Ventures)
- Live Events Produced: 30+
- Companies Founded/Co-founded: 4 (Hab Housing, SoleSearch, Cats Can Dance, Iterate)

## Complete Career Timeline

### Iterate — Founder & Creative Director (Jan 2026 – Present)
- AI-native marketing agency
- 90-person network across strategy, creative, and engineering
- Clients: ChargeZone, Noida International Airport, PickYourTrail, Billione, Monkspace
- Built on 15 years of operator instinct
- Website: hyperiterate.com

### Cats Can Dance — Founder (Mar 2026 – Present)
- Culture-discovery platform: music, fashion, and pet care
- Artist directory, event booking, music-production learning product
- Produced series of live shows pan-India with Impresario
- Launched under Iterate
- Website: catscandance.com

### Fere.ai — CMO (Jan 2025 – Dec 2025)
- Autonomous AI agent platform funded by Ethereal Ventures ($1.3M raised)
- Rejoined long-time collaborator Akshaya Aron
- Built growth and marketing function from scratch
- Restructured marketing to run lean — sustained by AI systems and small team
- Used operating model as proving ground for launching Iterate
- Website: fereai.xyz

### SoleSearch — Founder & CEO (2022 – Dec 2024)
- India's leading sneaker, streetwear, and collectibles marketplace
- Co-founded with Prabal Baghla; Rannvijay Singha joined as co-founder
- $6M+ total revenue over four years
- $795K raised from Venture Catalysts, Anthill Ventures, Cornerstone Ventures
- 350,000+ follower community
- 30+ live events including SneakinOut — India's first sneaker convention format (3 seasons with Swiggy SteppinOut)
- Omnichannel retail in Mumbai and Hyderabad
- Team of 40 people
- Press: VICE, CNBC-TV18, Storyboard18, Economic Times, Open Magazine, The Established, Business of Fashion

### Quartic.ai — Director of Marketing (2020 – 2022)
- Enterprise AI platform, headquartered in San Jose, California
- Led team of 5
- Backed by Good Capital, Celesta Capital, and Michael Marks
- Rejoined at direct invitation of Good Capital partners following Octo's acquisition
- Built marketing function from zero: brand identity, website, collateral, press strategy
- Website: quartic.ai

### Investopad → Good Capital — Partner, Growth & Technology (2017 – 2020)
- Family office turned institutional venture fund (Fund I)
- Sourcing, diligence, founder support for portfolio companies
- Portfolio: Meesho (now one of India's largest e-commerce companies), Entri, Simsim, Amazon, Forbes
- Based in New Delhi, India

### Octo — Founding Team, Head of Growth (2016 – 2017)
- Conversational AI platform, acquired by Quartic.ai
- Co-built with Akshaya Aron, backed by Good Capital
- Built AI products before "AI" was a market category
- One of India's first chatbots (2013)
- Built and ran entire marketing function from scratch
- Rebuilt product dashboard end-to-end, working directly with engineering

### Hab Housing — Founder (2012 – 2015)
- One of India's first branded budget-hospitality startups
- The category OYO later scaled nationally
- $120K+ revenue, fully bootstrapped
- Grew from sole founder to 16-person team across three cities (Pune, Bengaluru, etc.)

### GetRightPrice — Founding Team Member (2011 – 2012)
- India's first price-comparison engine for electronics
- Joined founding team in college
- Angel-backed by Sidharth Rao (founder, Webchutney — India's first digital agency)
- Built product catalog and crawl pipeline

## What Param Is Known For
- Building companies and brands from zero — not inheriting momentum
- Operating across the full GTM stack: positioning, brand, creative, demand gen, performance, product
- Building AI products before "AI" was a category (first chatbot in 2013)
- Creating cultural movements (SoleSearch built India's sneaker culture from nothing)
- Speed of execution — ships fast, iterates faster
- The "range is the point" — deliberate career breadth across industries as a compounding advantage
- AI-native marketing — using AI systems to replace headcount, not just augment
